blocks.content: Notification policies control how alerts are routed to contact points. For your first alert, the default policy is the quickest way to get alerts working.
To select a notification policy, complete the following steps:
In the alert rule form, scroll to **Section 5: Configure notifications**.

Leave **Use default policy** selected.

The default policy sends all alerts to the default contact point. This is the quickest way to get alerts working for your first rule.

Skip the override options for now:

- **Override grouping**: Keep defaults
- **Override timings**: Keep defaults

You'll learn to customize routing in a later module.
Your alert rule uses the default notification policy. Next, you'll make sure you have a contact point set up.
